description: This Java class implements a compile task for Android projects within the IntelliJ IDEA environment. It manages pre-compilation steps such as creating source roots, checking artifacts, and validating dependencies, specifically tailored for Android development workflows.

classes.name: AndroidPrecompileTask
classes.description: Implements a compile task for Android projects, handling pre-compilation setup, artifact validation, and dependency checks.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main entry point for executing the compile task, managing pre-compilation steps based on project configuration.

methods.name: prepareForCompilation
methods.description: Prepares the project for compilation by checking artifacts, dependencies, and excluding source roots as needed.

methods.name: createGenModulesAndSourceRoots
methods.description: Creates generated modules and source roots for Android facets within the project.

methods.name: checkArtifacts
methods.description: Validates build artifacts to ensure they are correctly configured and compatible with the current build session.

methods.name: getProGuardOptions
methods.description: Retrieves ProGuard configuration options for a given artifact.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts a collection of artifacts to a comma-separated string of their names.

methods.name: checkAndroidDependencies
methods.description: Checks for suspicious or unsupported Android module dependencies and warns or errors as appropriate.

methods.name: clearResCache
methods.description: Clears the resource cache for a given Android facet.

methods.name: unexcludeAllSourceRoots
methods.description: Removes source roots from the exclusion list to ensure they are included in compilation.

methods.name: excludeAllSourceRoots
methods.description: Excludes all source roots of a module from compilation.

methods.name: MyCompilationStatusListener
methods.description: Listens for compilation completion to restore excluded source roots.
